properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Storage Account: Shared Key Access Disabled (RBAC Only)
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Storage Accounts with shared key access enabled. FedRAMP High requires access enforcement (AC-3) via RBAC. Shared key access provides root-level access to the entire Storage Account without granular authorization — RBAC-only access enforces least privilege and integrates with Entra ID audit logging.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Storage Accounts with shared key access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
